name: Kamikaze Kenshi Rosetta Gaiden Yuria Yuukai
original_name: 神風剣士ロゼッタ外伝 Yuria 誘拐
source:
This is the story of Princess Julia, who appears in Kamikaze Kenshi Rosetta 2.

Princess Julia and her two maids are kidnapped by bandits to lure out Rosetta.

The player can choose to play as the bandit leader or as one of his lowest subordinate with the scenario that differs depending on the character played.

[Edited from the official website]
